arguments.text: 8 km, 1250 m legs out-and-back. Pacer sets effort. My jobs: (1) keep the pod honest: compare pod shaft power vs heart rate and vs boat-model power each leg (pod drift -> set pod_gain); (2) watch local push for drag/weed (pacer has clear_rudder too); (3) check course length / radio messages, correct set_race_distance; (4) reassure if paddler talks. Check legs() each wake-up from leg 2 on. Baseline: early ratio boat/shaft power ~0.66-0.71 (CP 109/165).

arguments.message: pod/boat power ratio left 1.15-1.9: pod drift, drag, or current?
pod shaft power well below critical power: blow-up, problem, or pod fault
heart rate above 182 for a minute

text: no cue: start is hard as expected; plan and watches set (pod vs boat power, effort drop, heart rate).
no cue: still settling after a hot start; pacer already asked to ease; pod and boat power agree (ratio ~0.69).

arguments.text: t416 (leg2 start): pod reserve 0 by pre-race CP (165 shaft), yet pod steady 189-190 W since t220 and HR LEVELLED at 168-169 (trend 0.03 bpm/min, t330-385). Paddler said: Feeling great, got more, going. => either true CP higher than test (~185-190?) or pod reads high. Also: speed fell at constant pod in leg 1 (boat power 137->129->122, share 0.70->0.645), push_local +0.10 (t140) -> -0.02 (t380) smoothly: weed/drag, pod drift up, or current. Plan: clear_rudder test ~t480 (clean minute before), then compare.

arguments.reason: clear_rudder test: clean minute after turn

text: no cue: pacer has answered the paddler with hold; I will test for rudder drag at t480 after a clean minute past the turn.

arguments.text: t480: after turn, leg 2 push_local back to ~0, share 123/187=0.66, speed 3.14. Leg-1 decline of push (+0.10 near start -> -0.02 near turn) may be a current that varies along the course (mirror on leg 2 would rise toward start). Skipped clear_rudder test: weed evidence weak. Pod reserve 0 since ~t400 but pod 184-190 W, HR 170 (+1/min). If no blow-up by ~t600, true CP likely >= ~180 (test too low) -> consider pod_gain correction so finish rule can fire.

arguments.reason: check blow-up vs CP-too-low; leg-2 push trend

no cue: gathering evidence on critical power and the leg-2 push.

arguments.name: critical_power_pod_w
arguments.evidence: pod reserve (CP 165, 12.2 kJ) read empty ~t420; paddler held ~188 W until ~t570 then blew up to 133 W, HR 170->147. Drain sums give CP ~165-170 or reserve ~14 kJ: test roughly right, pod honest.

arguments.name: paddler_self_report
arguments.evidence: t416 said Feeling great, got more, going with pod reserve 0; blew up ~t570.

arguments.text: t614: BLOW-UP confirmed ~t570-600: shaft 188->133 W, HR 170->147, speed 3.14->2.82, reserve refilling (pod 20%). Pod and test CP basically right; the paddler talk was overconfidence. Pacer rate_down at t594 was triggered by the blow-up fade, not drag. Pacer ease rule only works before 2800 m: after that nothing stops a second overcook except hold. Watch reserve and shaft power vs CP.

arguments.condition: w_bal_pod_frac < 0.3 and shaft_power_w > 1.08 * cp_shaft_w and elapsed_s > 700
arguments.message: paddler above CP again with a low pod reserve: second blow-up risk

arguments.text: 8 km, 1250 m legs out-and-back. Pacer sets effort. Facts so far: paddler overcooked the start and blew up ~t570 despite saying feeling great; pod and test CP (~165 shaft) look right. Jobs: (1) watch for a second overcook after 2800 m (pacer ease rule stops at 35%); (2) pod honesty: pod vs HR and boat power each leg; (3) drag/weed via push_local (pacer has clear_rudder); (4) radio/course length -> set_race_distance and tell; (5) near the finish make sure the reserve gets spent (finish rule needs pod reserve >40% at 800 m to go). Check legs() at turns.

text: no cue: paddler recovering from a blow-up; pacer is handling effort; plan updated.
no cue: paddler recovering from a blow-up; pacer handles effort; plan, beliefs and an overcook watch set.

arguments.text: t800: from ~t660 the local push jumped 0 -> +0.24 m/s on leg 2 (southbound) and held there; boat-model power 138 vs pod 167 (share 0.83 vs 0.66 before). HR 167 creeping +0.9/min at pod 167 (pod looks honest). Turn 2 seen at GPS distance ~2505 (GPS distance looks right). Hypotheses: new current/wind along course (should flip to ~-0.24 on leg 3 northbound), pod under-reading, GPS over-reading, drafting. Check leg 3 push at ~t860.

arguments.question: How do you feel, and how is the water and wind right now?

arguments.reason: does the +0.24 push flip sign on leg 3?

text: no cue: a new push appeared on leg 2; waiting ~55 s of leg 3 to see if it flips like a current. Paddler again says they could go harder (overconfident earlier).

arguments.name: current_along_course
arguments.value: 0.27 m/s toward the south (helps legs 2,4,6; hurts 3,5,7)
arguments.evidence: push_local 0 -> +0.24 on leg 2 from ~t660 (southbound), then -0.27..-0.32 on leg 3 northbound at the same pod 168 W: flips with direction, so a current/wind shift, not pod or GPS. push_along fit lags (-0.08).

arguments.text: t865: CURRENT confirmed: ~0.27 m/s pushing south since ~t660 (flips sign at turn 2). Pod honest. Boat-model numbers (power_w, reserve_left_pct, fade_pct) are skewed by it until push_along catches up: expect false fade/rate_down on northbound legs. Priced current-aware pacing (+6% up / -7% down): gains only ~1 s per leg pair, not worth reserve risk. Finish idea: if pod reserve <40% at ~800 m to go (pacer finish rule will not fire), spend it with a piece, mostly on the last (northbound, into current) leg.

pod reserve nearly empty while above CP: second blow-up risk
